label: TP
reason: User input via request parameters flows directly into bar variable which is then concatenated into strings printed to response.getWriter(), creating an XSS vector. The ternary operator logic (bar = (7 * 42) - num > 200 ? "This should never happen" : param;) evaluates to true (252 > 200), selecting the user-supplied param value, confirming the vulnerability path.

evidence.note: User param flows through ternary to bar and gets written to response
